fact_text: When you leave France to live abroad you must report your new foreign address to your last public-finance centre (dernier centre des finances publiques), which you can do online from your espace Finances publiques on impots.gouv.fr.
evidence_quote: Si vous partez a l'etranger au cours d'une annee N, vous devez signaler votre nouvelle adresse a votre dernier centre des finances publiques.

fact_text: Once the departure-year return is processed, if you still have French-source income taxable in France the Service des impots des particuliers non-residents (SIP-NR) becomes your new managing office for income tax.
evidence_quote: le service des impots des particuliers non-residents (SIP-NR) deviendra votre nouveau service gestionnaire pour l'impot sur le revenu.

fact_text: For the year of departure a non-resident files a form 2042-NR (in addition to the 2042) reporting only French-source income taxable in France from the departure date to 31 December of the departure year.
evidence_quote: un formulaire n. 2042-NR a cocher dans la declaration en ligne ou a telecharger sur le site impots.gouv.fr. Il ne doit comporter que vos revenus de source francaise imposables en France, de la date du depart au 31 decembre de l'annee du depart.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Split-year filing: the departure year is split between a full-year 2042 (income up to departure) and a 2042-NR (French-source income after departure). Many first-time movers do not know two forms are required.

fact_text: An employee who takes up expatriate status abroad is no longer attached to the French social security system and is instead affiliated to the social protection of the country where they go to work.
evidence_quote: Un salarie expatrie est une personne qui travaille a l'etranger et qui n'est plus rattache au regime de securite sociale francais.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Movers often assume the Carte Vitale keeps working abroad. Expatriate status ends attachment to the French regime from departure; SG has no public health scheme for Employment Pass holders, so a cover gap exists.

fact_text: An expatriate may voluntarily keep French health cover by joining the Caisse des Francais de l'etranger (CFE) for sickness, maternity, invalidity and work-accident risks.
evidence_quote: vous pouvez choisir de cotiser en plus a l'assurance maladie francaise en adherant a la Caisse des francais de l'etranger (CFE) pour la maladie, la maternite, l'invalidite, les accidents du travail et la maladie professionnelle.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: CFE is optional and top-up only; it does not replace host-country cover and must be arranged before or around departure to avoid a gap.

fact_text: The A1 certificate that keeps a posted worker in the French social security system applies to postings within the EU/EEA/Switzerland; for a posting outside that zone coverage depends on whether a bilateral social security convention exists, and France and Singapore have none, so the France->Singapore posted-worker position must be assessed by a lawyer.
evidence_quote: Apres accord de l'institution concernee, il doit vous remettre le document A1 (attestation concernant la legislation applicable).

applies_to.non_obvious_note: There is NO EU-style totalization for FR->SG. The French Senate (question ecrite n.00126, published 29/09/2022) confirms 'Il n'existe pas pour l'heure d'accord permettant la coordination des deux legislations de securite sociale' and that periods worked in Singapore do not count toward French pension quarters. Determination of any detachement certificate for SG needs lawyer review.

fact_text: The France-based employer must affiliate the expatriate to the French expatriate unemployment-insurance scheme, and this affiliation must take place within 8 days of the date the employee was expatriated.
evidence_quote: L'affiliation doit intervenir dans les 8 jours suivant la date a laquelle vous avez ete expatrie a l'etranger.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Tight 8-day employer deadline that is easily missed; it is an employer obligation, not the employee's.

fact_text: You must promptly declare your departure abroad to the CAF, and you stop receiving family benefits (prestations familiales) from the month of departure if your family accompanies you abroad.
evidence_quote: Je ne beneficie plus des prestations familiales des le mois de mon depart si ma famille m'accompagne a l'etranger.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: For Adrien, whose family relocates with him, CAF benefits end from the departure month; benefits paid during absence can be reclaimed by the CAF.
